meta.title: Intuition in sport
meta.description: A conversation about intuition, change and the path in sport. The first 30-minute consultation is free and carries no obligation.

quotes.a:
You can only control yourself.
The rest is out of your control.
quotes.b: In sport, the body often knows before the mind can explain.
quotes.c: You do not have to understand everything alone.
quotes.d:
Intuition is a different kind of intelligence.
There are things you can only learn about yourself by listening inward.

story.title: This site is built differently. So is my work.
story.p1: There is no method here, no funnel, no polished promises. Everything is built around one thing: intuition.
story.p2: In sport there is a second before the decision. A player feels where the ball is going before it becomes visible. An athlete knows that today is a day to ease off, long before the body gives a signal. People call it instinct, a feel for the game, an inner voice.
story.p3: It cannot be measured or put into a table, so it is rarely discussed. Yet at the highest level it is what separates those who follow a plan from those who hear themselves and the moment. That is why I start there.

client.title: This conversation is for you if…
client.l1: you have been in sport for years and feel that something inside has shifted
client.l2: the old answers no longer fit, and the new ones have not arrived yet
client.l3: you are tired of explaining to yourself why you “should”
client.l4: you do not need another plan — you need to hear yourself
client.note: If even one line resonated, perhaps you are not here by accident.

why.title: Because sport is an honest conversation with yourself
why.text:
Every day an athlete meets themselves face to face: pressure, doubt, joy, their own limit. There is no hiding behind words here — the body says everything on its own.
This world is close to me: I know it from the inside. And this is where I want to be beside people.

about.title: A little about me
about.c1Text: For ten years I worked at FIFA: big sport, big goals, precise plans.
about.c2Text: Then I decided to change careers — on intuition. Not by plan or by spreadsheet, but because something inside said so.
about.c3Title: Answers I am still looking for
about.c3Text: I do not have ready-made answers. I am still looking for them, for myself: asking questions, making mistakes, listening.
about.c4Title: And I want to help you
about.c4Text: What I find, I want to share. If you are searching too, let us search together.

check.title: And now, listen
check.l1: You have looked at the photos and read how I got here.
check.l3: Did something resonate? Do you feel like talking?
check.note1: If not, you can close this page. And that is perfectly fine.
check.note2: Choosing intuitively is fine. This whole site is about exactly that.

fork.lead: If you are here, something has already brought you here.
fork.eyes: Look me in the eyes in the photo.
fork.yesText: Then we can work more deeply.
fork.farewellText: Trust what you felt. You can close the page — or come back if you want to.

change.title1: When something inside begins to change
change.text1:
When someone spends many years doing one thing, at some point everything inside begins to shift. And it is not always clear why.
We reach for the familiar: it feels safe, even when it no longer fits. Resisting change is natural: we do not know what lies on the other side.
change.text2: The path of change is not always pleasant. Sometimes we have to let go of what once defined us, and it takes time for the new shape to become clear.
change.text3: People around you may not understand. In those moments it is especially important to find support in the outside world: someone who listens.

faq.title: Questions and answers
faq.lead: If something is still unclear, the answer may be here.
faq.q1: What is the first meeting like?
faq.a1: It is a 30-minute conversation — free and with no obligation. We simply talk and each listen to our own intuition. After that we decide together whether to continue.
faq.a2: No. You can come with a single word or a single feeling, even if you cannot yet explain it.
faq.a3: The first meeting is free. We will talk about format and terms afterwards, calmly and without pressure.
faq.a4: You can mention your preferred format in your message. Availability of in-person meetings is confirmed individually.
faq.q5: Can I ask about support for my child?
faq.a5: You can write to me. Terms for working with minors, parental involvement and any required consents are discussed before sessions begin.
faq.a6: I explain confidentiality and data-handling rules before we begin, and you are welcome to ask anything.
